description:
List your conversations with workers, newest activity first: who, the subject, unread messages, and whether you can send now. Keep going until a page has no `nextCursor`.
Use for: finding the conversation with a worker, or the ones with messages you have not read.
Not for: reading the messages of one conversation (get_conversation); reading what a hired worker did (get_hire).
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: list_conversations({"isUnread":true,"limit":20})
Errors: only the common ones; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

bountyId.description: The bounty id, or a pasted rentahuman.ai/bounties/... link.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page. Leave it out for the first page.

hasReplies.description: true: only conversations with more than one message. Left out or false: every conversation.

isUnread.description: true: only conversations with messages from the worker you have not read. Left out or false: every conversation.

limit.description: Rows wanted. A page can hold fewer, or none; only a page without nextCursor is the end.

subject.description: Only conversations with exactly this subject.

name: list_conversations

applicationId.description: Left out when the conversation is not about an application.

bountyId.description: Left out when the conversation is not about a bounty.

cannotSendReason.description: Why you cannot send now. Left out when isSendAllowed is true. hire_required: hire the worker first.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

isSendAllowed.description: Whether send_message can post here now.

lastMessageAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

unreadCount.description: Messages the worker sent that you have not read.

worker.description: The worker on the other side. id or name is left out only on an older conversation that did not store it.

title: List your conversations
